topic: Charisma: what charismatic leaders actually do
title: Can Charisma Be Taught? What Research Found
voiceover: Is charisma a gift, or a set of learnable tactics? In 2011, John Antonakis and colleagues tested whether charisma can be taught. They identified twelve charismatic leadership tactics. These included things like using metaphors and rhetorical questions. In the first study, 34 managers were randomized into training or not. In the second study, 41 MBA participants took part. Training improved how charismatic and effective the leaders were rated. The studies tested specific behaviors, as judged by others, not personality overall. Ratings of charisma alone don't tell us whether a leader's decisions are good. So in these studies, charisma looked more like a learnable set of behaviors than a fixed gift. Tomorrow: would you give a wrong answer just because everyone else did?

description: Is charisma a gift or a skill? In 2011, researchers identified twelve charismatic leadership tactics and found that training in them improved leaders' ratings in two studies. New psychology short every day on The Psyche Discourse. Source: Antonakis, J., Fenley, M., & Liechti, S. (2011). Can charisma be taught? Tests of two interventions. Academy of Management Learning & Education, 10(3), 374-396.
accuracy_note: Two studies (34 managers; 41 MBA participants), with charisma measured by others' ratings. The video does not claim charismatic leaders make good decisions.
